name: Noteri Control Plane Fallback Probe

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: 'Governed qualification or Rules219 read-only inventory'
        required: true
        type: choice
        default: qualification
        options:
          - qualification
          - rules219_readonly

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: noteri-control-plane-fallback-probe
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Canonical operational rules main used for the physical qualification.
  RULES_SHA: 6edb5990c777d487c41fb9ee48ccbf411b11d661
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"

jobs:
  probe:
    name: Qualify Noteri through Command Gateway
    if: github.repository == 'ericson-j-santos/noteri-runtime' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.actor == 'ericson-j-santos' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.mode == 'qualification'
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Windows, X64, noteri, reqsys-dev]
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout immutable workflow SHA
        uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout exact approved rules candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09
        with:
          repository: ericson-j-santos/chatgpt-operational-rules
          ref: ${{ env.RULES_SHA }}
          path: _rules
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify governed host qualification
        id: qualify
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          python3 -B scripts/noteri_qualification_entrypoint.py --confirm PROBE-NOTERI-CONTROL-PLANE --rules-root _rules --rules-sha "$env:RULES_SHA"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
      - name: Preserve sanitized qualification or blocked diagnostic
        if: always() && steps.qualify.outputs.receipt_path != ''
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: noteri-qualification-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ steps.qualify.outputs.receipt_path }}
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  independent_readback:
    name: Independently verify qualification and select transport
    needs: probe
    if: always() && github.repository == 'ericson-j-santos/noteri-runtime' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.actor == 'ericson-j-santos' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.mode == 'qualification'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 3
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout same producer revision
        uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout identical selector
        uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09
        with:
          repository: ericson-j-santos/chatgpt-operational-rules
          ref: ${{ env.RULES_SHA }}
          path: _rules
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Verify API job, artifact bytes, binding and selector result
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python -B scripts/noteri_qualification_receipt.py verify --rules-root _rules --rules-sha "$RULES_SHA" --output .tmp/qualification-decision.json
      - name: Preserve non-promoting decision
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: noteri-qualification-decision-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .tmp/qualification-decision.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  # Read-only mode reuses this owner's existing physical entrypoint. It is
  # disabled on push and on feature branches. No host install or model call.
  rules219_probe:
    name: Rules219 Noteri physical read-only inventory
    if: >-
      github.repository == 'ericson-j-santos/noteri-runtime' &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      github.actor == 'ericson-j-santos' &&
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      inputs.mode == 'rules219_readonly'
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Windows, X64, noteri, reqsys-dev]
    timeout-minutes: 5
    env:
      CONTROL_RULES_SHA: 58dcd4200f412a866278027ba9e433439a03f3b3
      SOURCE_RULES_SHA: 40e3db3ef8b1fe367d79b878b8d9d91930d2337b
      SOURCE_POOL_SHA: 87885bb8eab5c694b8d206a709b9a8c213cf5500
      CORRELATION_ID: noteri42-readonly-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
    outputs:
      receipt_b64: ${{ steps.readonly.outputs.receipt_b64 }}
      receipt_sha256: ${{ steps.readonly.outputs.receipt_sha256 }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout immutable Noteri main for the current dispatch
        uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout pinned canonical Session Launcher and Command Gateway
        uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09
        with:
          repository: ericson-j-santos/chatgpt-operational-rules
          ref: ${{ env.CONTROL_RULES_SHA }}
          path: _control_rules
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout pinned Rules219 source (read-only)
        uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09
        with:
          repository: ericson-j-santos/chatgpt-operational-rules
          ref: ${{ env.SOURCE_RULES_SHA }}
          path: _rules
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout pinned Worker Pool61 source (read-only)
        uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09
        with:
          repository: ericson-j-santos/engineering-worker-pool
          ref: ${{ env.SOURCE_POOL_SHA }}
          path: _worker_pool
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Admit isolated Session Launcher worktree and runner
        id: session
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          if ($env:COMPUTERNAME -ine 'Noteri' -or $env:RUNNER_NAME -cne 'Noteri-runtime') { throw 'NOTERI_219_WRONG_HOST' }
          $rules = Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE '_control_rules'
          $launcher = Join-Path $rules 'scripts/session_launcher.py'
          $policy = Join-Path $rules 'config/command-gateway.policy.json'
          $a = @('--policy', $policy, '--repo', $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE,
            '--session-prefix', 'noteri42-readonly', '--correlation-id', $env:CORRELATION_ID,
            '--expected-head', $env:GITHUB_SHA, '--sync-ref', 'origin/main',
            '--require-runner-version-preflight')
          $raw = & python3 -B $launcher @a
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $raw) { throw 'NOTERI_219_SESSION_BLOCKED' }
          $s = @($raw)[-1] | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
          if ($s.result -cne 'SESSION_LAUNCH_OK' -or $s.state_validated -ne $true -or
              $s.head -cne $env:GITHUB_SHA -or $s.snapshot_sha256 -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' -or
              -not $s.session_id -or -not $s.target_path) { throw 'NOTERI_219_SESSION_INVALID' }
          "target=$($s.target_path)" | Out-File $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append -Encoding ascii
          "session=$($s.session_id)" | Out-File $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append -Encoding ascii
          "snapshot=$($s.snapshot_sha256)" | Out-File $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append -Encoding ascii
      - name: Invoke pinned source and local Ollama GET through Gateway Risk1
        id: readonly
        shell: powershell
        env:
          SESSION_TARGET_PATH: ${{ steps.session.outputs.target }}
          SESSION_ID: ${{ steps.session.outputs.session }}
          SESSION_SNAPSHOT_SHA256: ${{ steps.session.outputs.snapshot }}
          SESSION_LAUNCH_RESULT: SESSION_LAUNCH_OK
          SESSION_STATE_VALIDATED: 'true'
          SESSION_GATEWAY_BOUND: 'true'
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $rules = Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE '_control_rules'
          $gateway = Join-Path $rules 'scripts/command_gateway.py'
          $policy = Join-Path $rules 'config/command-gateway.policy.json'
          $script = Join-Path $env:SESSION_TARGET_PATH 'scripts/noteri_rules219_readonly_admission.py'
          $a = @('--policy', $policy, '--correlation-id', $env:CORRELATION_ID,
            'run', '--cwd', $env:SESSION_TARGET_PATH, '--session-id', $env:SESSION_ID,
            '--risk', '1', '--timeout', '45', '--expected-head', $env:GITHUB_SHA,
            '--', 'python3', '-B', $script)
          $raw = & python3 -B $gateway @a
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $raw) { throw 'NOTERI_219_GATEWAY_BLOCKED' }
          $envelope = @($raw)[-1] | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
          if ($envelope.gateway_exit_code -ne 0 -or $envelope.state_changed -ne $false) { throw 'NOTERI_219_GATEWAY_INVALID' }
          $observed = $envelope.stdout | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
          if ($observed.result -cne 'NOTERI_219_READONLY_OBSERVATIONS' -or
              $observed.source_pins_verified -ne $true -or
              $observed.session_schema_checked -ne $true -or
              $observed.host_sha -cne $env:GITHUB_SHA -or
              $observed.rules_sha -cne $env:SOURCE_RULES_SHA -or
              $observed.worker_sha -cne $env:SOURCE_POOL_SHA -or
              $observed.model -cne 'qwen2.5-coder:7b' -or
              $observed.observed_model_digest -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' -or
              $observed.ready_for_builder -ne $false -or
              $observed.gateway_execution_attested -ne $false -or
              $observed.cost_zero_attested -ne $false -or
              $observed.lease_attested -ne $false -or
              $observed.artifact_cas_attested -ne $false -or
              $observed.activation_authorized -ne $false -or
              $observed.builder_executed -ne $false -or
              $observed.secrets_read -ne $false -or $observed.state_changed -ne $false) {
            throw 'NOTERI_219_READONLY_RECEIPT_INVALID'
          }
          # Cross-runner evidence is bounded and non-promoting. No artifact upload.
          $safe = [ordered]@{
            schema_version = 1; result = [string]$observed.result
            repository = [string]$env:GITHUB_REPOSITORY; host_sha = [string]$env:GITHUB_SHA
            rules_sha = [string]$observed.rules_sha; worker_sha = [string]$observed.worker_sha
            model = [string]$observed.model; model_digest = [string]$observed.observed_model_digest
            session_snapshot_sha256 = [string]$env:SESSION_SNAPSHOT_SHA256
            runner_name = [string]$env:RUNNER_NAME; session_id = [string]$env:SESSION_ID
            run_id = [string]$env:GITHUB_RUN_ID; attempt = [int]$env:GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT
            source_pins_verified = $true; ready_for_builder = $false
            cost_zero_attested = $false; activation_authorized = $false
            state_changed = $false; secrets_read = $false
          }
          $body = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes(($safe | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress))
          if ($body.Length -lt 200 -or $body.Length -gt 4096) { throw 'NOTERI_219_RECEIPT_SIZE_INVALID' }
          $sha256 = [Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
          try { $digest = [BitConverter]::ToString($sha256.ComputeHash($body)).Replace('-', '').ToLowerInvariant() }
          finally { $sha256.Dispose() }
          "receipt_b64=$([Convert]::ToBase64String($body))" | Out-File $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append -Encoding ascii
          "receipt_sha256=$digest" | Out-File $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append -Encoding ascii
          Write-Output 'NOTERI_219_PHYSICAL_READONLY_RECEIPT_OK'

  rules219_independent:
    name: Independent Rules219 Noteri physical receipt readback
    needs: rules219_probe
    if: >-
      needs.rules219_probe.result == 'success' &&
      github.repository == 'ericson-j-santos/noteri-runtime' &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      github.actor == 'ericson-j-santos' &&
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      inputs.mode == 'rules219_readonly'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 3
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    env:
      RECEIPT_B64: ${{ needs.rules219_probe.outputs.receipt_b64 }}
      RECEIPT_SHA256: ${{ needs.rules219_probe.outputs.receipt_sha256 }}
      EXPECTED_HOST_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
      EXPECTED_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
      EXPECTED_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
    steps:
      - name: Independently verify actual Noteri runner and exact run
        uses: actions/github-script@f28e40c7f34bde8b3046d885e986cb6290c5673b
        with:
          script: |
            const {data} = await github.rest.actions.listJobsForWorkflowRun({
              owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo,
              run_id: context.runId, per_page: 100
            });
            const jobs = data.jobs.filter(j => j.name === 'Rules219 Noteri physical read-only inventory');
            if (jobs.length !== 1 || jobs[0].status !== 'completed' ||
                jobs[0].conclusion !== 'success' ||
                jobs[0].runner_name !== 'Noteri-runtime' ||
                !Number.isInteger(jobs[0].runner_id) || jobs[0].runner_id <= 0 ||
                context.repo.owner !== 'ericson-j-santos' ||
                context.repo.repo !== 'noteri-runtime' ||
                context.ref !== 'refs/heads/main') {
              throw new Error('NOTERI_219_PHYSICAL_RUNNER_READBACK_BLOCKED');
            }
      - name: Independently verify receipt hash, run, SHA and non-promoting flags
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 -B - <<'PY'
          import base64, hashlib, json, os, re
          def require(ok, code):
              if not ok: raise SystemExit(code)
          payload = os.environ.get("RECEIPT_B64", "")
          digest = os.environ.get("RECEIPT_SHA256", "")
          require(bool(re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", digest)), "NOTERI_219_HASH_MISSING")
          require(50 <= len(payload) <= 5500, "NOTERI_219_RECEIPT_MISSING")
          try:
              raw = base64.b64decode(payload, validate=True)
              receipt = json.loads(raw)
          except (ValueError, TypeError):
              raise SystemExit("NOTERI_219_RECEIPT_CORRUPT")
          require(200 <= len(raw) <= 4096, "NOTERI_219_RECEIPT_BAD_SIZE")
          require(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == digest, "NOTERI_219_RECEIPT_TAMPERED")
          expected = {
              "schema_version": 1, "result": "NOTERI_219_READONLY_OBSERVATIONS",
              "repository": "ericson-j-santos/noteri-runtime",
              "host_sha": os.environ["EXPECTED_HOST_SHA"],
              "rules_sha": "40e3db3ef8b1fe367d79b878b8d9d91930d2337b",
              "worker_sha": "87885bb8eab5c694b8d206a709b9a8c213cf5500",
              "model": "qwen2.5-coder:7b", "runner_name": "Noteri-runtime",
              "run_id": os.environ["EXPECTED_RUN_ID"],
              "attempt": int(os.environ["EXPECTED_RUN_ATTEMPT"]),
              "source_pins_verified": True, "ready_for_builder": False,
              "cost_zero_attested": False, "activation_authorized": False,
              "state_changed": False, "secrets_read": False,
          }
          require(type(receipt) is dict and set(receipt) ==
              set(expected) | {"model_digest", "session_snapshot_sha256", "session_id"},
              "NOTERI_219_RECEIPT_SCHEMA_INVALID")
          require(all(type(receipt[k]) is type(v) and receipt[k] == v
              for k, v in expected.items()), "NOTERI_219_RECEIPT_IDENTITY_INVALID")
          require(bool(re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", receipt["model_digest"])) and
                  bool(re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", receipt["session_snapshot_sha256"])) and
                  type(receipt["session_id"]) is str and
                  bool(re.fullmatch("[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{3,64}", receipt["session_id"])),
                  "NOTERI_219_SESSION_OR_MODEL_INVALID")
          require(expected["ready_for_builder"] is False, "NOTERI_219_FALSE_READY")
          print("NOTERI_219_INDEPENDENT_READBACK_OK_READY_FALSE")
          PY

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only Rules #219 / Worker Pool #61 source and host admission inventory.

Only the existing, separately authorized Noteri Session Launcher + Command
Gateway may invoke this as Risk1. It cannot install, dispatch, stage, call Qwen
inference, claim a lease, grant cost approval, or certify READY_FOR_PR.

The source-only verifier is reusable by a hosted CI; its synthetic tests are
NEVER a physical host receipt.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

NOTERI_REPO = "ericson-j-santos/noteri-runtime"
RULES_REPO = "ericson-j-santos/chatgpt-operational-rules"
POOL_REPO = "ericson-j-santos/engineering-worker-pool"
RULES_SHA = "40e3db3ef8b1fe367d79b878b8d9d91930d2337b"
POOL_SHA = "87885bb8eab5c694b8d206a709b9a8c213cf5500"
MODEL = "qwen2.5-coder:7b"
SHA40 = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{40}\Z")
SHA64 = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{64}\Z")
PINNED_RULES_FILES = {
    "scripts/rules219_model_propose.py":
        "55a49ca39beb049f0f5d084eafa0c85f5e906ef4b9b366c32494f9e5fad37719",
    "scripts/rules219_model_apply.py":
        "eac267ea2d531e8e0d62326a6f48b73600c14df6cb4329884b0f609d1328ad05",
    "scripts/rules219_validator.py":
        "861560fe377e9c0e15eb5e5826859357bcce3d7bf2b3343eb93d90a2747943ee",
    "scripts/builder_manifest_stage.py":
        "422924c9bb5a409135328d41c1d5508ccd1e88da7fae02dc8beead5294ea1010",
}
POOL_BINDING_BLOB = "66e2a42a579c26901c63b8524a94dcdf76c17343"
MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES = 65536


class Blocked(RuntimeError):
    """Only fixed, non-sensitive codes are returned to an external runner."""


def require(ok: bool, reason: str) -> None:
    if not ok:
        raise Blocked(reason)


def git(root: Path, *args: str) -> bytes:
    """All Git observations are fixed read-only commands without a shell."""
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["git", "-C", str(root), *args], check=False,
            capture_output=True, timeout=15,
            env={
                "PATH": os.environ.get("PATH", os.defpath),
                "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL": os.devnull,
                "GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM": os.devnull,
                "GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT": "0", "LC_ALL": "C",
            },
        )
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
        raise Blocked("NOTERI_219_GIT_UNAVAILABLE") from None
    require(result.returncode == 0 and len(result.stdout) <= MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES,
            "NOTERI_219_GIT_READBACK_INVALID")
    return result.stdout


def verify_checkout(root: Path, *, repository: str, sha: str) -> None:
    """No checkout, fetch, pull, status mutation or branch change."""
    require(root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink()
            and root == root.resolve(), "NOTERI_219_SOURCE_PATH_INVALID")
    observed = git(root, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel").decode("utf-8", "strict").strip()
    require(Path(observed).resolve() == root,
            "NOTERI_219_SOURCE_ROOT_MISMATCH")
    require(git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip() == sha
            and git(root, "rev-parse", "--abbrev-ref", "HEAD").strip()
            == b"HEAD",
            "NOTERI_219_SOURCE_SHA_DRIFT")
    # The expected detached checkout still needs an authenticated origin.
    remote = git(root, "remote", "get-url", "origin").decode().strip()
    require(remote in {
        f"https://github.com/{repository}",
        f"https://github.com/{repository}.git",
    }, "NOTERI_219_SOURCE_ORIGIN_DRIFT")
    require(git(root, "remote").splitlines() == [b"origin"],
            "NOTERI_219_SOURCE_EXTRA_REMOTE")
    # Do not misinterpret sibling repositories under the runner's checkout as
    # source changes; separately validate their tracked bytes below.
    require(not git(root, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no"),
            "NOTERI_219_SOURCE_TRACKED_DIRTY")
    if repository != NOTERI_REPO:
        require(not git(root, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all"),
                "NOTERI_219_SOURCE_UNTRACKED")


def verify_file(root: Path, relative: str, *, digest: str) -> None:
    file = root / relative
    require(file.is_file() and not file.is_symlink()
            and file.resolve().is_relative_to(root)
            and file.stat().st_size <= 256000,
            "NOTERI_219_SOURCE_FILE_INVALID")
    body = file.read_bytes()
    require(hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest() == digest,
            "NOTERI_219_SOURCE_FILE_DIGEST_DRIFT")
    # Prevent a working tree file from disagreeing with its pinned Git object.
    require(git(root, "show", "HEAD:" + relative) == body,
            "NOTERI_219_SOURCE_INDEX_DRIFT")


def verify_pins(*, host: Path, rules: Path, pool: Path,
                host_sha: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Verify exact original repositories, Git commit SHAs, and script bytes."""
    require(SHA40.fullmatch(host_sha) is not None,
            "NOTERI_219_HOST_SHA_INVALID")
    require(len({host, rules, pool}) == 3,
            "NOTERI_219_NONISOLATED_CHECKOUT")
    for root, repo, sha in (
        (host, NOTERI_REPO, host_sha),
        (rules, RULES_REPO, RULES_SHA),
        (pool, POOL_REPO, POOL_SHA),
    ):
        verify_checkout(root, repository=repo, sha=sha)
    # A hosted CI may have two independent checkout directories nested under
    # its source workspace. Only these exact untracked roots are tolerable.
    permitted = {
        "?? " + str(other.relative_to(host)).replace("\\", "/") + "/"
        for other in (rules, pool) if other.is_relative_to(host)

"""Rules #219 source-pin and host observation tests. No physical Noteri calls."""
from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest import mock

from scripts import noteri_rules219_readonly_admission as gate


class ReadonlyPinsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name).resolve()
        self.repo = self.root / "repo"
        self.repo.mkdir()
        self.git("init", "-q")
        (self.repo / "file.py").write_text("VERSION = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
        self.git("add", "--all")
        self.git("-c", "user.name=IsolatedTest",
                 "-c", "user.email=test@example.invalid",
                 "commit", "-qm", "source")
        self.sha = self.git("rev-parse", "HEAD").strip()
        self.git("checkout", "--detach", "-q", self.sha)
        self.git("remote", "add", "origin",
                 "https://github.com/ericson-j-santos/noteri-runtime.git")

    def git(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(self.repo), *args],
                              capture_output=True, check=True, text=True).stdout

    def test_real_git_detached_clean_source_positive(self):
        gate.verify_checkout(self.repo, repository=gate.NOTERI_REPO, sha=self.sha)

    def test_wrong_commit_fails(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.Blocked, "SOURCE_SHA_DRIFT"):
            gate.verify_checkout(self.repo, repository=gate.NOTERI_REPO,
                                 sha="0" * 40)

    def test_wrong_remote_fails(self):
        self.git("remote", "set-url", "origin", "https://example.invalid/repo.git")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.Blocked, "SOURCE_ORIGIN_DRIFT"):
            gate.verify_checkout(self.repo, repository=gate.NOTERI_REPO, sha=self.sha)

    def test_local_branch_fails(self):
        self.git("switch", "-q", "-c", "candidate")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.Blocked, "SOURCE_SHA_DRIFT"):
            gate.verify_checkout(self.repo, repository=gate.NOTERI_REPO, sha=self.sha)

    def test_tracked_mutation_fails(self):
        (self.repo / "file.py").write_text("CHANGED = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.Blocked, "SOURCE_TRACKED_DIRTY"):
            gate.verify_checkout(self.repo, repository=gate.NOTERI_REPO, sha=self.sha)

    def test_rules_checkout_untracked_file_fails_closed(self):
        self.git("remote", "set-url", "origin",
                 "https://github.com/ericson-j-santos/chatgpt-operational-rules.git")
        (self.repo / "extra.py").write_text("unexpected = True\n")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.Blocked, "SOURCE_UNTRACKED"):
            gate.verify_checkout(self.repo, repository=gate.RULES_REPO, sha=self.sha)

        data = (self.repo / "file.py").read_bytes()
        gate.verify_file(self.repo, "file.py",
                         digest=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(gate.Blocked, "SOURCE_FILE_DIGEST_DRIFT"):
            gate.verify_file(self.repo, "file.py", digest="f" * 64)
